qc.label_under_test: The token 'purpose' in purpose-built or purposefully descriptions of designed objects.

neighbours.label: The token just before an expected 'made' or 'built' (purpose|built, tailor|made, custom|designed, 'models are|made', a product description's final period before 'Made of…'); the word 'made' itself and 'purpose' as a plain noun stay quiet
fire: The company moved into a purpose-built facility on the edge of town last spring.
She wore a tailor-made suit to the awards dinner.
Every kitchen we install features custom-designed cabinets that fit your exact space.
Most large language models are made by training on huge collections of text.
This backpack is light, roomy and water resistant. Made of recycled nylon, it will last for years.
The stadium is a purpose-built venue for track cycling.
The role seemed tailor-made for someone with her background in logistics.
Our cedar planter is sturdy and easy to assemble. Made of untreated wood, it ages to a soft silver.
quiet: The company moved into a large rented facility on the edge of town last spring.
She wore a dark grey suit to the awards dinner.
Every kitchen we install features solid oak cabinets that fit your exact space.
Most large language models need huge collections of text and a lot of electricity.
This backpack is light, roomy and water resistant, and it comes in three colors with a two-year warranty.
The purpose of the stadium is to give local cyclists a place to race.
The tailor closed his shop early and walked home along the river.
Our cedar planter is sturdy and easy to assemble, and it ships free to any address in the country.

predictions: 6/8 fire; near misses mostly quiet. Risk: the period-before-'Made of' items are weaker than the prefix items.
